title: Create README workflow examples as tests
description:
Created comprehensive workflow test that demonstrates core pebbles functionality.

## What Was Implemented

Created tests/workflows/core-workflow.trycmd covering:
1. List all issues
2. Filter by status and type
3. Show issue details
4. Update issue status
5. Link issues to epic (part_of relationship)
6. Add dependency relationships (required_for)
7. View epic with child issues
8. Update issue title (with file renaming)
9. Complete issues (status to done)
10. Create new issues dynamically

## Test Infrastructure

- .in/ directory with clean initial state (4 issues: bug, usecase, design, epic)
- .out/ directory with expected final state after workflow
- Pattern matching for dynamic content ([..] for UUIDs, timestamps)
- File system verification (trycmd compares .out/ to actual result)
- No jj operations (.no_jj marker for safe testing)
- Trailing newlines added to JSON output (POSIX compliance)

## Key Learnings

- PEBBLES_DB_PATH env var not needed (trycmd sets CWD automatically)
- Pattern matching [..] works in both stdout and file content
- trycmd automatically creates temp directories from .in/ fixtures
- TRYCMD=overwrite regenerates expectations after code changes

## Success Criteria Met

✅ Core workflow tested and passing
✅ Tests serve as living documentation
✅ Both stdout and filesystem state verified
✅ Pattern matching handles dynamic content
✅ cargo test passes
